faq.desc: Everything you need to know about our video animation services.

items.q: What is the standard turnaround time for a 60-second video?
items.a: A typical high-quality 60-second explainer video takes approximately 10-15 business days, including scripting, storyboarding, animation, and voiceover synchronization.

items.q: Which software do you use for motion graphics?
items.a: We use industry-standard tools including Adobe After Effects for motion, Cinema 4D for 3D elements, and Adobe Premiere Pro for final editing and sound design.

items.q: Do you provide voiceover services in multiple languages?
items.a: Yes! We provide professional voiceover services in Hindi, English, and various regional languages as per your target audience requirements.

items.q: How many revisions are included in the price?
items.a: We include up to 3 rounds of revisions at each major milestone (Script, Storyboard, and Final Animation) to ensure the result is exactly what you envisioned.

items.q: Can you create content for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts?
items.a: Absolutely! We specialize in creating high-impact vertical video content (9:16 aspect ratio) designed specifically to grab attention in social media feeds.

items.q: Do I own the copyrights to the final video?
items.a: Yes, once the final payment is cleared, full ownership and copyrights of the final rendered video are transferred to you for use across any platform.

items.q: What information do you need to start my project?
items.a: We initially need your goal for the video, target audience, preferred style (2D, 3D, Typography), and any specific key messages you want to include.

items.q: Do you provide 3D motion graphics as well?
items.a: Yes, alongside standard 2D explainer and kinetic animations, we specialize in high-end 3D motion graphics for product visualizations and brand reveals.
